gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Nanum Myeongjo reads quietly refined, its strokes thickening and thinning just enough to feel like a text serif with manners. Bellota Text answers with one flat, rope-like line, and that gap is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-serif-hk: Bellota Text draws its headings in strokes that never swell or thin, with open, commanding curves. And Noto Serif HK follows with a classic serif's gentle gradient of weight, crossbars a touch slimmer than the stems.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-serif-jp: Blunt, bold, and a bit unusual up top. Noto Serif JP then brings the quieter talent, thin strokes sitting close to thick, while Bellota Text keeps to its commanding lines of unchanging thickness.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-serif-sc: Literary in mood, Noto Serif SC rounds its letters with a slight pressure shadow, like worn charcoal, and keeps its openings clear. But Bellota Text holds every stem and tail at the same rope-like thickness, so a long stretch of text keeps its gentle texture.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-serif-tc: Traditional in spirit, Noto Serif TC keeps its letters held open and its modulation quiet, a text serif made for steady reading. Bellota Text is the stencil-cut one, best at flat, striking headlines.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-petrona: Bellota Text sets a commanding, blueprint-like line of constant thickness above Petrona, a text serif with a shallow terminal curl. Over a long passage, Petrona's tempered contrast moves along without jolting or flattening.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-poly: Poly is bookish, with pulled-back terminals and gently thinned bowls. Over a long passage this classic serif feels literary and settled, while Bellota Text above it keeps every stroke at constant thickness, commanding and distinctive.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-quattrocento: Flat and bold above, classic below. Quattrocento slims its horizontals and leaves visible daylight in every curve, so a classic serif like this keeps a long passage moving, while Bellota Text holds its line unswelling.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-radley: Radley brings authoritative serif strokes, robust downstrokes with slender turns and hairlines present but not razor thin. Bellota Text meets it with a blunt, round-tipped marker feel, distinctive and commanding.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-roboto-serif: Bellota Text lays its strokes like twine pressed flat. Roboto Serif, a text serif with big open eyes and well-spaced letters, lets a long passage swell gently along its curves and feel dignified.
